headline: Rabbit launches OS3 AI agent without R1 hardware
summary: Rabbit is launching OS3, a cross-platform AI agent that runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac and Linux, letting users skip its underwhelming R1 hardware.

claims.statement: Rabbit is launching OS3, a cross-platform AI agent that doesn't require its R1 hardware.

sources.quote: Rabbit is launching OS3, a cross-platform agent that lives on the screens you already use
Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run

claims.statement: OS3 runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices.
